# Rekonsiliasi

```{r prepare}
recon_map <- params$result$idx_reconcile_map
recon_tbl <- params$result$idx_reconcile_table

recon_available <- (!is.null(recon_map) && inherits(recon_map, "sf")) || !is.null(recon_tbl)

if (recon_available && is.null(recon_tbl)) {
  recon_tbl <- sf::st_drop_geometry(recon_map)
} else if (!is.null(recon_tbl)) {
  recon_tbl <- as.data.frame(recon_tbl)
}

status_col <- if (!is.null(recon_tbl)) {
  intersect(c("Reconcile", "reconcile", "status", "Status", "Adjacent", "adjacent"), names(recon_tbl))[1]
} else {
  NA_character_
}

recon_step <- tryCatch(as.integer(params$inputs$recon_step[1]),
                       error = function(e) NA_integer_)
case_label <- if (is.na(recon_step)) {
  "Tidak Diketahui"
} else if (recon_step == 1L) {
  "Tumpang Tindih"
} else if (recon_step == 2L) {
  "Bertetangga"
} else {
  "Tidak Diketahui"
}

alpha_val <- tryCatch(as.numeric(params$inputs$alpha[1]),
                      error = function(e) NA_real_)
alpha_txt <- if (is.na(alpha_val)) {
  "tidak diketahui"
} else {
  format(alpha_val, nsmall = 2)
}
alpha_src <- tryCatch(as.character(params$inputs$alpha_source[1]),
                      error = function(e) NA_character_)
```

## Ringkasan Umum

```{r ringkasan}
if (!recon_available) {
  cat("\n*Tidak ada hasil analisis rekonsiliasi yang tersedia dalam laporan ini.*\n")
} else {
  n_feat <- nrow(recon_tbl)
  n_yes  <- if ("Reconcile" %in% names(recon_tbl)) {
    sum(recon_tbl$Reconcile == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  } else NA_integer_
  n_no   <- if ("Reconcile" %in% names(recon_tbl)) {
    sum(recon_tbl$Reconcile == "No", na.rm = TRUE)
  } else NA_integer_
  
  total_area <- if ("area_ha" %in% names(recon_tbl)) {
    sum(as.numeric(recon_tbl$area_ha), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else NA_real_
  
  if (!is.na(status_col) && "Yes" %in% recon_tbl[[status_col]]) {
    adj_tbl <- recon_tbl[recon_tbl[[status_col]] == "Yes", ]
    wt <- if ("area_ha" %in% names(adj_tbl)) adj_tbl$area_ha else rep(1, nrow(adj_tbl))
    wtsum <- sum(wt, na.rm = TRUE)
    wavg <- function(col) sum(adj_tbl[[col]] * wt, na.rm = TRUE) / wtsum
  } else {
    wt <- if ("area_ha" %in% names(recon_tbl)) recon_tbl$area_ha else rep(1, nrow(recon_tbl))
    wtsum <- sum(wt, na.rm = TRUE)
    wavg <- function(col) sum(recon_tbl[[col]] * wt, na.rm = TRUE) / wtsum
  }
  
  padan_old <- if ("idx_padan" %in% names(recon_tbl)) wavg("idx_padan") else NA
  padan_new <- if ("idx_padan_new" %in% names(recon_tbl)) wavg("idx_padan_new") else NA
  inc_padan <- if (!is.na(padan_old) && !is.na(padan_new)) padan_new - padan_old else NA
  
  serasi_old <- if ("idx_serasi" %in% names(recon_tbl)) wavg("idx_serasi") else NA
  serasi_new <- if ("idx_serasi_new" %in% names(recon_tbl)) wavg("idx_serasi_new") else NA
  inc_serasi <- if (!is.na(serasi_old) && !is.na(serasi_new)) serasi_new - serasi_old else NA
  
  padu_col_new <- if ("idx_padu_new" %in% names(recon_tbl)) "idx_padu_new" else
                  if ("idx_padu_final" %in% names(recon_tbl)) "idx_padu_final" else NA_character_
  padu_old <- if ("idx_padu_final" %in% names(recon_tbl)) wavg("idx_padu_final") else NA
  padu_new <- if (!is.na(padu_col_new)) wavg(padu_col_new) else NA
  inc_padu <- if (!is.na(padu_old) && !is.na(padu_new)) padu_new - padu_old else NA
  
  format_inc <- function(val) {
    if (is.na(val) || is.null(val)) return("N/A")
    if (val > 0) paste0("<span style='color:#27ae60;'>&#9650; +", fmt2(val), "</span>")
    else if (val < 0) paste0("<span style='color:#e74c3c;'>&#9660; ", fmt2(val), "</span>")
    else paste0("<span style='color:#7f8c8d;'>= ", fmt2(val), "</span>")
  }
  
  make_card <- function(label, old_val, new_val, inc) {
    paste0(
      "<div style='flex:1; text-align:center; padding:0 15px;'>",
      "<div style='font-size:13px; color:#7f8c8d; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.5px;'>",
      label, "</div>",
      "<div style='font-size:22px; font-weight:bold; margin:8px 0;'>",
      fmt2(old_val), " &rarr; ", fmt2(new_val), "</div>",
      "<div style='font-size:15px;'>", format_inc(inc), "</div>",
      "</div>"
    )
  }
  
  summary_stats <- data.frame(
    Statistik = c(
      "Kasus rekonsiliasi",
      "Kawasan direkonsiliasi",
      "Kawasan tetap",
      "Alpha (\u03B1) yang digunakan"
    ),
    Nilai = c(
      case_label,
      if (is.na(n_yes)) "tidak tersedia" else as.character(n_yes),
      if (is.na(n_no))  "tidak tersedia" else as.character(n_no),
      alpha_txt
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

   summary_ui <- htmltools::div(
     style = "background:#fff; border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; padding:20px; margin-bottom:25px; box-shadow:0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);",
     htmltools::h3(
       style = "margin-top:0; color:#2c3e50; text-align:center;",
       "Peningkatan Nilai Indeks (Agregat)"
     ),
     htmltools::div(
       style = "display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:15px; flex-wrap:wrap; border-top:1px solid #eee; padding-top:15px;",
       htmltools::HTML(make_card("Indeks SERASI", serasi_old, serasi_new, inc_serasi)),
       htmltools::div(style = "border-right:1px solid #eee;"),
       htmltools::HTML(make_card("Indeks PADU",   padu_old,   padu_new,   inc_padu)),
       htmltools::div(style = "border-right:1px solid #eee;"),
       htmltools::HTML(make_card("Indeks PADAN",  padan_old,  padan_new,  inc_padan))
     )
   )
   
  summary_dt <- DT::datatable(
    summary_stats,
    rownames = FALSE,
    options  = list(dom = 't', pageLength = 10, ordering = FALSE),
    caption  = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: 600;",
      "Ringkasan Hasil Rekonsiliasi"
    )
  )

  htmltools::tagList(summary_ui, summary_dt)
}
```


## Tentang Modul

Modul Rekonsiliasi menerapkan keputusan pengguna pada setiap kasus konflik integrasi untuk diimplementasikan pada peta RTRWP terintegrasi. Peta gabungan yang dihasilkan menandai kawasan yang direkonsiliasi dan kawasan yang tetap seperti semula.

## Hasil Rekonsiliasi

```{r result}
if (!recon_available) {
  cat("\n*Hasil analisis rekonsiliasi tidak tersedia.*\n")
} else {
    is_adjacent <- identical(params$inputs$case, "adjacent") ||
                   (!is.na(recon_step) && recon_step == 2L)
    case_suffix <- if (is_adjacent) "adjacent" else "overlaps"
    
    log_dir <- if (!is.null(params$inputs$output_dir) && nzchar(params$inputs$output_dir)) {
      file.path(params$inputs$output_dir, "Rekonsiliasi", "log")
    } else {
      file.path(getwd(), "Rekonsiliasi", "log")
    }
    
    png_candidates <- c(
      file.path(log_dir, sprintf("reconcile_map_%s.png", case_suffix)),
      file.path(log_dir, "recon_status.png")
    )
    png_path <- png_candidates[file.exists(png_candidates)][1]
    
    if (!is.na(png_path) && file.size(png_path) > 0) {
      knitr::include_graphics(png_path)
    } else if (is_adjacent) {
      if (!is.na(status_col) && !is.null(recon_map)) {
        static_plot <- tryCatch(
          plot_categorical_map(
            map    = recon_map,
            column = status_col,
            title  = "Peta Status Rekonsiliasi",
            legend = "Status Rekonsiliasi",
            colors = c("Yes" = "#2B8CBE", "No" = "#BDBDBD")
          ),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        if (!is.null(static_plot)) print(static_plot) else cat("Peta statis tidak tersedia.")
      } else {
        cat("Peta statis tidak tersedia.")
      }
    } else {
      if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")
      pacman::p_load(leaflet, htmltools, htmlwidgets, sf, dplyr)
      
      map_data <- recon_map %>%
        sf::st_transform(crs = 4326) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(.row_id = dplyr::row_number() - 1L)
      
      pal <- leaflet::colorFactor(
        palette  = c("Yes" = "#2B8CBE", "No" = "#BDBDBD"),
        domain   = map_data$Reconcile,
        na.color = "#808080"
      )
      
      leaflet::leaflet(map_data) %>%
        leaflet::addProviderTiles(leaflet::providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap) %>%
        leaflet::addPolygons(
          fillColor = pal(map_data$Reconcile), 
          fillOpacity = 0.7, color = "#444", weight = 0.8,
          label = ~paste0("<b>ID PU:</b> ", original_id_pu, "<br>", "<b>Rekonsiliasi:</b> ", Reconcile) |> lapply(HTML)
        ) %>%
        leaflet::addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~Reconcile, title = "Status Rekonsiliasi", position = "bottomright")
    }
}
```


```{r result2}
if (recon_available) {
  tbl <- recon_tbl
  
  pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
    nm <- names(df)
    hit <- nm[match(tolower(candidates), tolower(nm))]
    hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)]
    if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
  }

  pick_col_rx <- function(df, pattern) {
    hit <- grep(pattern, names(df), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
  }
  
  col_rtrw      <- pick_col(tbl, c("RTRW", "rtrw"))
  col_rzwp      <- pick_col(tbl, c("RZWP3K", "rzwp3k"))
  col_zone_old  <- pick_col(tbl, c("zoning_old", "zoning old", "zoning_lama", "zone_old", "old_zoning", "zona_lama", "kawasan_lama"))
  if (is.na(col_zone_old)) col_zone_old <- pick_col_rx(tbl, "(zon|kawasan).*(old|lama|aktual)|(old|lama|aktual).*(zon|kawasan)")
  col_zone_new  <- pick_col(tbl, c("zoning_new", "zoning new", "zoning_baru", "zone_new", "new_zoning", "zona_baru", "kawasan_baru"))
  if (is.na(col_zone_new)) col_zone_new <- pick_col_rx(tbl, "(zon|kawasan).*(new|baru)|(new|baru).*(zon|kawasan)")
  adjacent_col  <- pick_col(tbl, c("Adjacent", "adjacent"))

  sort_col <- if (!is.na(adjacent_col)) adjacent_col else status_col
  if (!is.na(sort_col)) {
    ord <- order(as.character(tbl[[sort_col]]) != "Yes", na.last = TRUE)
    tbl <- tbl[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  col_map <- c(
    "RTRW"                 = col_rtrw,
    "RZWP3K"               = col_rzwp,
    "Kawasan Lama"         = col_zone_old,
    "Kawasan Baru"         = col_zone_new,
    "Bertetangga?"         = adjacent_col,
    "Sumber"               = pick_col(tbl, "Source"),
    "Rekonsiliasi?"        = pick_col(tbl, "Reconcile"),
    "Luas (ha)"            = pick_col(tbl, "area_ha"),
    "Indeks PADAN"         = pick_col(tbl, "idx_padan"),
    "Indeks PADAN Baru"    = pick_col(tbl, "idx_padan_new"),
    "Selisih Indeks PADAN" = pick_col(tbl, "delta_idx_padan"),
    "Indeks SERASI"        = pick_col(tbl, "idx_serasi"),
    "Indeks SERASI Baru"   = pick_col(tbl, "idx_serasi_new")
  )
  col_map <- col_map[!is.na(col_map)]
  col_map <- col_map[!duplicated(unname(col_map))]  
  
  recon_tbl_view <- as.data.frame(tbl[, unname(col_map), drop = FALSE])
  if (inherits(recon_tbl_view, "sf")) recon_tbl_view <- sf::st_drop_geometry(recon_tbl_view)
  names(recon_tbl_view) <- names(col_map)

  round_cols <- intersect(
    c("Luas (ha)", "Indeks SERASI", "Indeks PADAN",
      "Indeks SERASI Baru", "Indeks PADAN Baru", "Selisih Indeks PADAN"),
    names(recon_tbl_view)
  )
  for (col in round_cols) {
    recon_tbl_view[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(recon_tbl_view[[col]]))
  }

  dt <- DT::datatable(
    recon_tbl_view,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter   = "top",
    options  = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      scrollX    = TRUE,
      scrollY    = "350px",
      scroller   = TRUE
    )
  )
  if (length(round_cols) > 0) {
    dt <- DT::formatRound(dt, columns = round_cols, digits = 2)
  }
  dt
}
```
